_comment: Overrides for shared/stablecoins.ts discovery. allow/deny accept CODE:ISSUER, CODE@domain or @domain. Allowlisted assets skip heuristics but are still toml-verified when possible; if the toml fetch fails they count as verified ('allowlisted'). circle.com's stellar.toml returned 404 when this was generated (2026-09-25), so Circle's USDC/EURC issuers are pinned here explicitly.
